description: Every countable family of infinite subsets of the natural numbers has a common splitter; every countable family of subsets leaves some infinite set unsplit by all its members.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.countable_families :
  (∀ (F : Set (Set ℕ)),
      F.Countable → (∀ X ∈ F, X.Infinite) → ∃ S, ∀ X ∈ F, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.Splits S X) ∧
    ∀ (F : Set (Set ℕ)), F.Countable → ∃ P, P.Infinite ∧ ∀ S ∈ F, ¬Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.Splits S P
